overall: Atlanta is running significantly below expectations this morning, with current temps stuck at 73.4°F under a completely overcast (OVC) sky with a low ceiling of 122m. forecast_obs_notes: NWP models cluster tightly in the 83.9–86.2°F range (HRRR=83.9, ECMWF=85.5, NBM=86.2), all running well below the NWS narrative high of 88°F, and this gap between official forecast and model guidance is notable. max_temp_prediction: The META model (most reliable) places its highest probability in the 84–85°F bucket at 32.2%, with a probability-weighted expected value near 86°F, but given the persistent OVC ceiling through mid-morning and only +0.9°F/hr 2-hour velocity, a top near 85–86°F seems most likely if skies partially clear by early afternoon as forecast.
